# Short #011 - En L'An 2000: France in the Year 2000

## Title options (1 = recommended)
1. In 1899, French Artists Drew the Year 2000
2. Flying Taxis and Whale Buses: 1899 Predictions for the Year 2000
3. The 1899 Cards That Predicted the Robot Vacuum

## Description
En L'An 2000 ("In the Year 2000") is a series of at least 78 French illustrated cards, the first made by Jean-Marc Côté for the 1900 World Exhibition in Paris. They imagined air cabs, flying police, an electric floor scrubber, a whale-drawn bus and underwater croquet. The cards were never distributed; they were rediscovered decades later and published by Isaac Asimov in Futuredays (1986).

Visuals are AI-generated concept art, not photographs or historical footage.

- The Public Domain Review: "Lost Futures: A 19th-Century Vision of the Year 2000"
